name: Topics API on Android
plain: Android would have told ad SDKs a few interest topics from the person's recent app use.
meaning: Coarse interest labels (about 470 topics) for ad targeting without an ID. Retired in Oct 2025 after low adoption.

android.store_policy: Privacy Sandbox status page lists as scheduled for phaseout (page updated Aug 2026)
android.note: Google announced on 17 Oct 2025 it is retiring this along with most Privacy Sandbox APIs. No Android removal date was stated in the announcement.

limits.headline: Can't tell ad tools your interest topics on Android, since Google retired it
limits.user_action: Nothing. It was a background feature, retired in October 2025
can: Have told ad tools a few topics from about 470 labels (Android 13 and later)
Have worked without an ad ID
Have used your recent app use to pick topics
cannot: Run on iPhone; it is not an Apple feature
Keep going after the 17 Oct 2025 retirement announcement
limits.differs: Android only. iPhone never had it.

story.what_it_is: A retired plan where Android would tell ad code a few broad interests from your app use.

marketing.name: Topics API on Android
marketing.pitch: Coarse interest topics for ads, with no ad ID. Google retired it in October 2025.

story.for_you: You would have seen ads tied to topics like 'Fitness' or 'Travel', based on your phone's recent app use, without any ID following you.
story.for_makers: About 470 coarse topics would have been shared with ad SDKs. Low adoption led Google to retire it in October 2025, and ad tech turned to first party data and AI models.

use_cases.example: An ad network asks Topics for three interests and shows a running shoe ad.
A game uses a topic like 'Gaming' to pick a fitting ad without an ID.
A news app picks ads that fit 'Travel' without sharing its readers' history.
A retailer buys ads for 'Home and Garden' people.
Topics are rotated weekly and have noise, so they cannot single out one person.
Developers tested Topics and found fewer signals than the advertising ID gave.

story.ios_note: iOS never offered an equal interest API.

technical_bounds: Retired: do not build new features on this
Ad ID stays the main cross-app identifier

legit_uses: Was meant as an ID-free ad system

history.change: Topics preview in Privacy Sandbox developer preview
